title: flt.c_highshelf~
description: `flt.c_highshelf~` calculates biquad coefficients for a high-shelf filter that boosts or cuts frequencies above a specified frequency. Set the frequency from 20 to 20,000 Hz and gain from -15 to +15 dB; its five outlets provide `b0`, `b1`, `b2`, `a1`, and `a2`, suitable for `flt.biquad~`.
